name: GCSE Biology Prep: Biovane
subtitle: GCSE Biology: labs and quizzes
shortDescription: Adaptive GCSE biology revision: lessons, quizzes that fix your gaps, 10 labs for the required practicals and board-style mocks for AQA, Edexcel and OCR.
longDescription:
Revise GCSE biology the way a good teacher would teach it. Biovane checks what you know, sends you to the exact lesson for what you missed, and chooses what to practise next. It is built for separate-science GCSE Biology, with every point of the AQA 8461 content listed in Coverage and matched at topic level to Pearson Edexcel 1BI0 and OCR Gateway and Twenty First Century courses.

### How It Adapts
- Short quizzes after every lesson and lab, at the level you choose: Foundation, Core or Higher.
- Your mastery of each topic is stored on your device only and fades over time, so topics you have not seen for a while come back for review.
- After a quiz or test you get links to the exact lessons you missed and a one-line reason for what comes next.
- Unit tests, a skills test, a cumulative check and board-style mock papers end with a report and a study plan.
- Optional Curriculum map: see where each topic sits in A Level, IB and AP Biology.

### Two Ways to Study
- Syllabus view: follow the specification in order, topic by topic.
- Real-World view: solve a real problem. Run a safe microbe lab, plan a sports diet, respond to an outbreak, manage type 1 diabetes, survey a woodland or protect a species. Each step teaches what you need, checks you, and puts the finished deliverable on your Made-it shelf.

### Labs You Can Move
- Microscope Lab: magnification, image size and real size.
- Enzyme Lab: temperature and pH curves for amylase, pepsin and trypsin.
- Genetics Lab: Punnett squares, ratios and simulated offspring.
- Reaction Time Lab: test yourself and compare conditions.
- Osmosis, Photosynthesis, Fieldwork, Blood Glucose, Natural Selection and Microbe Labs with Plus.

224 specification points, 70 lessons with diagrams and worked examples, and more than 2,400 original questions. Text zoom from 50 to 300 percent. Everything works offline.
